page.overview:
Who is Basil III at-Tam?

Emperor Basil III at-Tam (d. 2391 AG), also called Basil the Blue, was Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 2385–2391 AG), succeeding his brother Hamin Costin VIII as ruler of the Corrino Imperium.

In 2391, by his uncle, the Sardaukar commander Harmhab Menemtahe. Harmhab then seized control of the government as regent.
